read_accounting.warning: Counts are packet-local scoped reads, not cumulative totals. Distinct math fragments are separately previewed formula nodes, not separate equations or every inline term displayed within prose/listings. HGB source includes isolated other-model formulas but does not constitute rereads of their original papers.

primary_methods.title: Relation-Aware Graph Foundation Model
primary_methods.takeaway: REEF conditions aggregator/classifier generators on relation tokens, and dataset projector/bias on dataset descriptions. Its v2 heterograph extension uses typed projections and canonical relations on original HGB ACM/DBLP splits; its complete recipe includes text encoders/SVD/augmentation/multi-dataset pretraining. Exact interrelation generator tying is unclear from relation-indexed notation without code.
primary_methods.candidate_difference: One supervised CP-factorized member×canonical-relation output scaling on shared native HGT message cores, without REEF generator/pretraining/text pipeline. Conditional parameter generation is attributed; complete-method equality not claimed.
primary_methods.remaining_qualification: No author code/source/pretraining/native HGB reproduction; source performance paragraph incidental and ignored.

primary_methods.title: Empowering Heterogeneous Graph Foundation Models via Decoupled Relation Alignment
primary_methods.takeaway: DRSA shares fixed random low-rank endpoint-type bilinear operators across relations, estimates structure-driven representations and decomposes semantics/residuals before a shared pretraining encoder. Printed M_r=A_source B_target^T gives the same operator for same endpoint types.
primary_methods.candidate_difference: Canonical-relation private diagonal tensor interaction during supervised recurrent HGT, rather than multi-domain preprocessing/latent reconstruction. Typed low-rank sharing itself is prior.
primary_methods.remaining_qualification: Convergence/source assumptions/implementation not independently audited; no native few-shot transfer or cost reproduction.

primary_methods.title: Are we really making much progress? Revisiting, benchmarking, and refining heterogeneous graph neural networks
primary_methods.takeaway: HGB standardizes complete benchmark releases, preprocessing, splits/evaluation. Simple-HGN adds learned typed-edge attention, node/edge residuals, multi-head aggregation and output normalization to GAT. Competent native GAT is necessary; author HGT/Simple-HGN/GAT recipes were scoped.
primary_methods.candidate_difference: Four member states and shared HGT cores with CP-generated output factors; no new benchmark or typed-attention ingredient claimed.
primary_methods.remaining_qualification: Paper metadata only; no dataset files/release revision/use history, code or exact executable recipe qualification.

retained_prior_attribution.established: Shared dense cores/private fast scales; exact same-site diagonal residual-path equivalence.
Relation bases/type-relation maps; private attention/state computation and fixed semantic preprocessing boundary.
Compact typed structural adaptation and structure-conditioned frozen experts/routing; complete pipelines differ.

retained_prior_attribution.family: CP tensor factorization and conditional adaptation
retained_prior_attribution.established: Low-rank multi-index parameter sharing; c_m q_r u is an established factorized conditional-adapter form, not a new factorization.

composition.exact_operation: Layer-specific one-CP-residual relation-output fast factors b_mr=b_m+c_m q_r u around native shared HGT relation-message maps, M4 complete private states, ordinary own TRAIN CE, fixed mean-logit pool.
composition.utility_gap: Whether relation-dependent private response freedom improves prediction over global BE and capacity controls while sharing dense cores and compact tensor factors.
composition.scientific_disposition: One prospective controlled quality test; source/tolerances/use history/adoption remain root-owned. Components are established and utility is unmeasured.

initialization_boundary: Function-preserving c0 can preserve identical routes with identical c gradients; all-zero product is dead; antithetic c with q0 cancels symmetric pooled q gradient. Prospective nonzero CP products change initial function; nonzero Jacobians do not ensure useful loss gradients.
